changelog:
• Multi-Layer Chart State Persistence (v3.5): Isolated per-symbol storage (%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeltaTerminal\Charts\{SYMBOL}\chart.json) with in-memory LRU cache, atomic temp writes, and automatic corruption recovery
• Decoupled WebEngine Manager: Independent lifecycle & readiness architecture (chart_ready vs market_data_ready vs trading_ready) with deterministic 7-phase startup state machine
• Trade Feasibility Engine: Small-stop margin limit pre-flight analytics, maximum_executable_risk bound calculation, and contextual [ 📐 Widen Stop ], [ 🔻 Lower Risk ], [ ⚡ Fit Bal ] smart actions
• Section 25 Limit Order Price Protection: Strict tick normalization without drifting, snapping, or overwriting limit orders with market price
• High-Precision Performance Instrumentation: High-resolution hardware telemetry tracking milestone latencies and P50/P95/P99 latency percentiles
• Fully Operable Dynamic-R Live Pipeline: Seamless side normalization, dual product/symbol indexing, and local paper execution
• 120 FPS Fluid Performance: DirectX 11 DirectComposition pipeline, zero-copy shaders, and coalesced price tick updates
